authoring.author: claude (kinkerstraat even-side faces lane)
authoring.note: Kinkerstraat 178-142 (even side), 2024-12-11 overcast strip. 178-168: a 1989 flats block (kinker-1985-infill placed with its own grid: four storeys of tall windows with white sill lines, projecting balcony stacks, a continuous canopy with a glazed parapet over the shops). 166-160: a 1904-05 row of 2-axis modules with yellow brick courses and blocked arches (kinker-1890-brick-arched by eye; the cluster put kinker-1895-painted-band). 156-158: a 1976 infill with recessed loggias. 154-144: plain-brick fronts with anchors and pediment dormers. 142: a Neo-Renaissance step gable. Grey gap between 144 and 142 (no pand on the face).
